description: This file is a PHP script responsible for rendering the detailed view of a role within the ACL Roles module of SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It initializes Smarty templates, retrieves role data, assigns variables for display, and includes subpanels for related data.

classes.name: SubPanelTiles
classes.description: A class responsible for managing and displaying subpanels within the module detail view.

methods.name: getClassicModuleTitle
methods.description: Generates and displays the classic module title header with breadcrumbs.
